name: circrnadisease

relevance.justification: circRNADisease v2.0 (now serving expanded v3.0 data live) is a manually curated resource of experimentally-supported circRNA-disease associations: circRNA identity (circBase ID/name/synonym/host gene), disease (mapped to MONDO ontology IDs), expression direction (up/down-regulated), detection method (RT-qPCR, RNA-seq, Northern blot, microarray, etc.), a continuous confidence score, PMID provenance, and free-text mechanistic description. This is a direct fit for pending.api as a circRNA↔disease association edge resource. Docked one point (not 5) because circRNA is not a first-class entity type in any current BioThings core API (MyGene/MyDisease/MyVariant/MyChem), so ingestion requires a custom association schema rather than slotting into an existing entity type.

novelty.justification: No existing BioThings API or pending.api plugin covers circRNA-disease associations (grepped references/existing-biothings-plugins.json and references/pending-api-datasources.json for 'circ' — no hits). The only other circRNA plugin in this pipeline's history, `circtarget`, covers circRNA-target RNA interactions (a different relation type entirely, verified by inspecting agent_outputs/circtarget_datasource/circtarget_relevancy.json). MyDisease.info has MONDO disease terms but no circRNA cross-references. This dataset is the first curated circRNA-disease evidence resource available to the pipeline: 15,423 curated evidence rows (9,659 unique PMIDs) spanning 656 MONDO disease terms and ~4,970 distinct circBase-style circRNA IDs (plus additional rows identified only by circ_rna_name where a formal circBase ID was not yet assigned), each with a per-record confidence score not found anywhere else in BioThings.

openness.justification: Live TXT/XLSX bulk downloads at cgga.org.cn/circRNADisease/download/ return HTTP 200 with correct content-types (text/plain, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet) with no login, API key, or click-through gate. The NAR publication states the article (and by extension the described dataset) is distributed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial License (CC BY-NC), which permits non-commercial reuse and redistribution with attribution but restricts commercial use. Score capped at 3 (not 5) for the NC restriction; no separate site-level license/terms page could be found (about.jsp / license pages 404), so the license basis is the paper's stated CC BY-NC rather than a site-published one.

evidence.scope: Manually curated, experimentally-supported circRNA-disease associations. Each row links one PMID-sourced observation to a circRNA (circBase ID/synonym/host gene/species), a disease (free-text label + MONDO ontology ID/name), an expression direction, a detection method, a mechanistic free-text description, and a continuous confidence score (0.069-0.908 observed range).
evidence.overlap: No direct overlap with existing BioThings sources. MyDisease.info already carries MONDO terms as an entity but has no circRNA cross-reference field. The evidentiary/mechanistic layer (detection method, expression direction, confidence score, mechanistic description) is entirely new to BioThings.

license.name: CC BY-NC (paper-stated; no separate site license page found)
restrictions: Non-commercial use only per the NAR publication's stated license

urls.api: No public API found; checked homepage, help.jsp, and common /api paths

risks: Site now serves 'circRNADisease v3.0' data live (15,423 assoc. rows / 656 MONDO terms per the download page text) rather than the v2.0 figures reported in the 2024 NAR paper (6,998 assoc. / 330 diseases / 4,246 circRNAs) — the underlying database has grown since publication; the live bulk files are the most current and complete data available and were used for inspection.

circrna_id field is empty in ~37% of rows (5,733/15,423); circ_rna_name is used as the fallback circRNA label in most of those cases (4,052 rows), so _id construction must fall back across multiple columns.
No separate license/terms page found on the live site (about.jsp, license.jsp return 404) — license basis relies solely on the paper's CC BY-NC statement.
No public API — bulk-download-only ingestion path.
next_actions: Proceed to plugin generation using the bulk TXT download as the primary source
